title: Zchat · Backend and PostgreSQL
description: HTTP gateway routes are grouped under /api/; gRPC panels show individual RPCs. Socket lifetimes and /metrics are excluded from HTTP latency. Request bytes count bytes consumed by handlers, not declared Content-Length. WebSocket writes are not delivery acknowledgements. Empty panels mean no samples, not a measured zero.

panels.title: Broadcast queue depth
panels.description: Capacity256 broadcasts. A sample may miss short peaks; enqueue failures preserve evidence of failed admission.

panels.title: Per-client queue utilization p95
panels.description: Distribution observed before each enqueue, not an instantaneous gauge.

panels.title: Successfully written WS messages / s
panels.description: to_client counts successful frame writes; receipt is verified separately by k6.

panels.title: Go CPU cores
panels.description: One unit = one CPU core. Container limit is recorded in compose.load.yaml.

panels.title: DB pool wait seconds / s
panels.description: Aggregate waiting across callers; can exceed one second per second.
